name: navigator-agent-builder-surface-reconciliation
body:
Reconciliation record (spec-writer, `agent-builder-agents-md` change-set — discovered-work amendment, [autonomous] unless noted).

SOURCE / DISCOVERED GAP. During implementation the change-set was found to also need `opencode-suite/agents/codebase-navigator.md` edited, not just `opencode-suite/agents/agent-builder.md`. The navigator prompt narrates the agent-builder's main-write surface but under-describes it: it says only `.opencode/agents/**` — already stale re the `opencode.json` agent→model map (`requirements.requirement.agent-builder-model-map`), and now also stale re the repo-root `AGENTS.md` hygiene (`requirements.requirement.agent-builder-agents-md-hygiene`). Verified in the branch file (`opencode-suite/agents/codebase-navigator.md`, now 678 lines): the project-flow carve-outs paragraph (lines 176-181) names `.opencode/agents/**` as ""the one place committed work lands on main outside a worktree""; the ""Codebase agents"" bullet (lines 508-512) says ""its only write grant is `.opencode/agents/**`""; and the scoped ""Main is never a mutation place"" bullet (lines 524-529) names only the `.opencode/agents/**` edits. This also answers open question 1 of `requirements.note.agent-builder-agents-md-hygiene`, which deliberately deferred the navigator-prompt widening to a future change-set.

FIX INTENT. The navigator prompt must NOT restate/under-describe the agent-builder's main-write surface — it references the agent-builder's own definition (`opencode-suite/agents/agent-builder.md`) — while still stating what the NAVIGATOR needs operationally: that it tasks `agent-builder` on main, commits there, rebases the worktree, re-scans, and the user restarts opencode; and that this maintenance includes the repo-root `AGENTS.md` hygiene and the `opencode.json` model map ALONGSIDE the agent scaffold. This is the mirror of the process-ownership rule: the navigator owns the canonical change-set process, the agent-builder owns the enumeration of its own write surface.

VERIFIED against the branch graph: `opencode-suite/agents/codebase-navigator.md` is a real scanned `docs` File node (678 lines) whose Structs include `md.opencode-suite/agents/codebase-navigator.md.codebase-navigator.project-flow-operational` (line 160) and `...codebase-navigator.graph-schema.codebase-agents-delegate-never-scaffold-or-implement-yourself` (line 492) — so the `implemented-by` target resolves and NO planned Implementation node is needed.

DISTINCTNESS from `requirements.requirement.agent-builder-agents-md-hygiene`. That requirement edits `opencode-suite/agents/agent-builder.md` (the agent-builder OWNS `AGENTS.md` hygiene; implemented-by `agent-builder.md` via `solution.component.agent-builder-agents-md-hygiene`). THIS requirement edits `opencode-suite/agents/codebase-navigator.md` (the NAVIGATOR prompt accurately references that surface; implemented-by `codebase-navigator.md` via `solution.component.navigator-agent-builder-surface`). Different edited file, different component, different `implemented-by` target — coverage maps 1:1 to each. No existing requirement is satisfied by this amendment; the plan satisfies ONLY `requirements.requirement.navigator-agent-builder-surface-coherence` with a NEW phase/task over `opencode-suite/agents/codebase-navigator.md`.

WHY A NEW DOMAIN ENTITY. `domain.entity.agent-main-write-surface` is distinct from `domain.entity.repo-agent-guide-surface` (the guide's hygiene contract) and `domain.entity.agent-scaffold-flow` (the on-main lifecycle): it is the three-path surface as a referenced whole — the thing a narrator prompt must account for. Driving the existing `repo-agent-guide-surface` would couple this requirement's coverage to the agent-builder file and pull in an untouched target.

SPINE. `requirements.user.navigator-agent ⊃ requirements.requirement.navigator-agent-builder-surface-coherence —drives→ domain.entity.agent-main-write-surface —realised-by→ solution.component.navigator-agent-builder-surface —implemented-by→ opencode-suite/agents/codebase-navigator.md`.

NON-GOALS. `opencode-suite/agents/agent-builder.md`, `AGENTS.md`, and the repo's own `.opencode/agents/**` are NOT edited by this requirement. This note has no `details` edge to another Note (that pair is refused at write time); it is attached to the requirement.
